JlZDRkYWQ4MmUxZWRlZWQ2MDRlMDY1N2YyNDZiYmZmNjA1NGU2ZTNkY2YzOTExY2M2IiwidGFnIjoiIn0%3D; snippethtb_%3D { "email" : "admin@snippet.htb" , "password" : "admin" , "remember" : false } I’ll need the X-XSRF-TOKEN header, both cookies, as well as the Content-Type header to send JSON (and the JSON payload).
